description: This file defines a handler class for processing passthrough endpoint requests with guardrails in a machine learning infrastructure. It includes methods for extracting targeted data fields, applying guardrail policies, and handling input/output processing in the context of guardrail enforcement.

classes.name: PassThroughEndpointHandler
classes.description: A handler class designed to process passthrough endpoint requests with integrated guardrail logic, including methods for extracting data, and applying guardrails for request and response data.

methods.name: Optional[PassThroughGuardrailSettings] _get_guardrail_settings( self, litellm_logging_obj: Optional["LiteLLMLoggingObj"], guardrail_name: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Retrieves guardrail settings for a specific guardrail from the logging object.

methods.name: str _extract_text_for_guardrail( self, data: dict, field_expressions: Optional[List[str]], )
methods.description: Extracts targeted text data from input, either specific fields or the entire payload excluding internal fields.

methods.name: Any process_input_messages( self, data: dict, guardrail_to_apply: "CustomGuardrail", litellm_logging_obj: Optional["LiteLLMLoggingObj"] = None, )
methods.description: Processes input messages by applying guardrail policies to the relevant data fields.

methods.name: Any process_output_response( self, response: Any, guardrail_to_apply: "CustomGuardrail", litellm_logging_obj: Optional["LiteLLMLoggingObj"] = None, user_api_key_dict: Optional[Any] = None, )
methods.description: Processes output responses by applying guardrail policies to specific fields in the response data.
